cases.translation: In the twenty-third year of the reign of Joash.
cases.explain: The preposition на (in) with temporal meaning governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The anger of the Lord was aroused against Israel.
cases.explain: The noun stands as the subject of воспламенился.

cases.translation: Asked the face of the Lord for help.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/with) governs the genitive case.
The transitive verb дал (gave) takes the accusative case.
The preposition на with accusative indicates movement toward a location.

cases.translation: At the end of Jehoahaz's reign.
cases.explain: The preposition по (at) governs the prepositional case.
The preposition при (by/near/in) governs the prepositional case.

He entreated the Lord and the Lord heard him
